faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in San Bruno?
faq.answer: San Bruno homeowners typically invest $5,500 to $12,500 for a full window replacement project covering 10–15 windows. This Peninsula city's 1950s–1970s ranch homes and split-levels offer some of the most efficient replacement projects in San Mateo County. Acoustic upgrade packages for homes near SFO may add modestly to cost. Single window installation starts at approximately $490.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in San Bruno?
faq.answer: Yes. San Bruno requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team manages all permit applications with the City of San Bruno Building & Safety Division on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in San Bruno?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in San Bruno commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in San Bruno?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most San Bruno replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in San Bruno?
faq.answer: Most San Bruno projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
